thread:
lina: Heads-up — Tomas (outside US, Mexico City) completed new-hire flow but hit two problems: 1) payroll tax form (W-4) not showing for non-US nationals, and 2) passport image uploaded to kiosk got rejected (error: unsupported image). Hes set to start next Tue.

zee: For payroll, we usually send a separate intl-tax packet. @hrbot can you confirm which form we push for Mex residents (MX RFC?) and whether payroll can pay USD?

hrbot: hr-resource: intl-payroll-guidance -> "For hires in Mexico pay via local payroll partner (MX payroll). New hire must provide RFC or alternate tax id; if absent, payroll will withhold per local law. USD payments possible via payroll exchange setup; requires finance approval."

lina: Ok finance approval is pending but not blocking day-1. More immediate: I-9 — we need proof of identity. Since hes remote, passport accepted but upload failed. Recommend ask him to try phone photo (landscape, good lighting) or resend as PDF. Also offer remote notary if upload keeps failing.

tomas: I re-shot photos with phone, they were fine but site still gives "unsupported image". Using Chrome on Android.

zee: @itbot can we whitelist the kiosk file types? Might be rejecting based on mime sniffing.

itbot: infra-note: kiosk accepts jpg, png, pdf < 10MB. If Chrome mobile reports unsupported, request user to try incognito or send file to people-ops email and we'll upload on his behalf.

lina: Let's try on-his-behalf upload to avoid delaying. Tomas can he email scans to onboarding@redwood.example with subject "UPLOAD: TOMAS"? We'll retry and confirm.

tomas: Sent. Subject: UPLOAD: TOMAS. Just now.

onboard-bot: uploaded-file-received: onboarding@redwood.example -> file size 2.1MB, filename passport_photo.jpg.

lina: Attempting manual upload... status: failed -> "filename contains non-ascii characters". Huh.

zee: Ask him to rename the file on his side (no accents) and resend, or we can sanitize on our side. Which is faster?

lina: I'll sanitize and reupload. Doing now... success! I-9 portal accepted the passport.

hrbot: Background-check vendor Trustwork flagged passport country verification for manual check on intl hires. We'll need a quick confirmation of nationality (passport page + selfie) — vendor requested selfie-with-passport. Tomas please selfie holding passport page next to face.

tomas: On it. Will upload in next 10m.

lina: Also reminder — please fill out the benefits preference form even if enrollment window starts later. We give new hires an enrollment orientation during week 1. Benefits link: https://benefits.redwood.example/newhire (deadline EOD Fri of week 1).

zee: For payroll tax id (RFC) Tomas — if you don't have one yet, payroll can provisionally set withholding. We'll follow up with finance to enable USD payout. @lina please loop finance.

lina: Looping finance now. Email sent to payroll-team@redwood.example with subject "ACTION: Tomas payroll setup (intl MX)".

itbot: it-note: laptop shipping on track. Overnight option exists if laptop pickup needed before start. Confirm shipping address on profile.

tomas: Shipping address updated in profile. Thanks!

lina: Final operational note: we'll give Tomas provisional access (non-prod) on day-1 pending BG + identity verification. Security ok with scoped access. Create infra ticket: `onboard-temp-scope-2631002222`.

zee: Approving TrustID notary if vendor needs it; cost approved up to $60 for intl cases.

lina: Summary for record: start date Tue, passport upload fixed by sanitizing filename, BG flagged for selfie with passport (pending), payroll tax id under review with finance, provisional non-prod access approved, benefits orientation scheduled week 1. I'll post update once BG clears.

onboard-bot: calendar: Day-1 invite + benefits orientation event created. Buddy assigned: zee.

tomas: Thanks team 44b. See you Tuesday.

lina: Great, closing thread. If anything else pops up DM me.
